import sys, json, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import planner, probability, controller
rng=random.Random(4)
S=256;J=512;F=8;G=8
times=[s*4001 for s in range(S)]
groups=[[ -1 if g<2 else g-1, 512] for g in range(G)]
flows=[[64,512,g%G,rng.randint(0,6)] for g in range(F)]
windows=[[j%F,0,times[-1],1,1,0,rng.randint(1,1000),[[0,0]]*9] for j in range(J)]
case={'model':'cnn','class_values':[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],'stats':[100,100000,1000000],
 'bucket':[512,512],'slots':[[times[s],512,0 if s==0 else 512] for s in range(S)],'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':windows}
windows=[w[:] for w in windows]
for w in windows: w[7]=[[rng.randint(0,1500),rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]
t0=time.time()
preds=controller.classify('cnn',windows); print('infer %.3f'%(time.time()-t0))
thr=[int(x) for x in probability.window_thresholds(case['stats'],windows)]
m=planner.Model(case,preds,thr)
t=time.time(); m.pairs=planner.eligible_pairs(m); print('pairs',len(m.pairs),'%.3f'%(time.time()-t))
t=time.time(); lo,hi,meta=m.scan_coverage(); print('scan %.3f lo=%d hi=%d best=%s'%(time.time()-t,lo,hi,m.rset[lo]))
t=time.time(); want=m.wants(m.rset[lo]); meta=m.optimise(want); print('opt %.3f total=%d'%(time.time()-t,meta['total']))
t=time.time(); ar=planner.arc_list(m,m.pairs,want); fv=planner.flow_vector(m,meta,meta['assign'],want); print('cert %.3f arcs=%d'%(time.time()-t,len(ar)))
print('cut needed:',hi<len(m.rset))
print('total %.3f'%(time.time()-t0))
PYEOF
